C(q) -> 2+log2 e+K0+12/5 = 26.9494 as q -> infinity; hence sup over all prime powers q of H(PP_q)/I(PP_q) is finite, although every DNF of PP_q has read >= q+1.

claims.exact_statement: If every Boolean f admits a union-of-gates cover (gates = Boolean functions of at most M regular functions, M absolute) whose label, subset and rank/rarity functionals in B03-R-REFINED-WITNESS-BOUND are each at most C I(f), then H(f) <= C' I(f) for all f (FEI).
claims.first_unproved_line: Every f has a gate cover with (L)+(S)+(R) <= C I(f). False for DNF covers of majority (label cost about log k ~ n per set against I ~ sqrt n); open for regular-gate covers; equivalent in strength to C020.
